items.name: syntari
items.title: Syntari trust helpers
items.description: Action requests, the Syntari icon vocabulary, and the shared styles every Syntari React component uses. No dependencies beyond React.

items.name: tool-approval
items.docs: A request is never permission: check scope and policy in onActionRequest before anything runs. Host-only props, such as risk and status, come from your app, never from model output.
